summary_en: Presents an integrated high-frequency spherical-array device that performs real-time three-dimensional tomographic optoacoustic imaging concurrently with focused-ultrasound emission. Ex vivo mouse-brain and in vivo sheep experiments demonstrate treatment targeting and optoacoustic monitoring of thermal-lesion progression, enabling on-the-fly thermal-dose adjustment.
